Library · Hard

Alert Limit: 6 · Loot: Treasure · For: an experienced crew

The Objective

A rare book in the locked reference section of a public library. It contains a spider map — a generational silk record of every web in the city. Someone wants it back. Someone else wants it more.

What the Crew Sees at the Score

Three floors; the reference section is on the second, behind a locked glass case. In plain sight: a head librarian who stays late and is extraordinarily observant, and the library cat — enormous, and it has seen things.

Intel the crew can uncover by Casing — one true detail per Success:

  • The librarian's route covers every floor on an irregular schedule.
  • The case uses an antique lock (Engineering 4).
  • There are two stairwells and a dumbwaiter between floors.

ST information. Don't foreshadow it in the Score — let it arrive.

Another crew is already inside, after the same book.

1. Entry — a guard spider (not hired, just lives here) near the entry point, with feelings about the reference section.
  2. The librarian's late-night route. Every floor, irregular timing.
  3. The locked case. Antique lock, Engineering Difficulty 4.
  4. (Unknown) The other crew. Negotiate, compete, or recruit — all three are valid.
